description: Nasjonalt rutedatasett for kollektivtrafikk i Norge is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by developer.entur.org. Entur was established in 2017 to gather information about public transport services all of Norway in order to promote collective travel more accessible. We maintain a self-service database where the Norwegian public transport companies independently upload data whenever there are changes in their services. Coverage: NO. The portal shows the English title as "National dataset for public transport information in Norway" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include sanntid, rutetider, reiseplanlegging, real-time, time table information, journey planning. The listing shows 6 download or service links in JSON, XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
